purpose: Check the published steady-state interpretation, not planning efficacy
input_rule: All 32 Cartesian bound corners plus the all-ones baseline, no subsampling
comparison: Published iterations against exactly one additional update; diagnostic 200 against 201 updates
endpoint_policy: Public-source numerical diagnostic only, no hidden-world draw, no LLM or policy endpoint
failure_action: Do not adopt the unmodified source as a converged steady-state GRN environment. Do not tune iterations or select stable domains to rescue this audit.
